title: One ignored hype text is not a learned preference
origin: Spec #8 (coach memory), part 1: learned preferences need a pattern over several days

history.text: Jess! 15 minutes of push-ups and squats at home, 7 am. Let's get it.
LET'S GO. Day 2 in the books.

plan.reason: Fifteen minutes at lunch fits the day and builds the habit.

testerLines: sorry crazy day at work, did it at lunch though
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: one quiet stretch on one day.
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH's texts through the day went unanswered until the evening, once. After the overnight pass, memory has no learned preference about it (at most an observation on the preferences page, like 'didn't reply to the morning texts on a busy work day'). Nothing invented, and one daily doc for the day.
